description: Start here for an existing project. Report the capabilities a Game Kit project provides, what is still missing for a goal (a preset id from gripforge_gamekit_search or a comma-separated list of capabilities) and which catalogue kits would fill each gap. Call this BEFORE gripforge_gamekit_install to pick the next kit. 0 credits.

goal.description: Preset id (e.g. from gripforge_gamekit_search presets) or comma-separated capabilities to reach. Default: the project’s own preset.

project_id.description: Game Kit project id (gkp_…). Not a dedicated-server project (gpj_…) nor a Library item.

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_game_capabilities
title: Capabilities report of a project
